content: 'Aitsika yeutari memɨ'itiya meta memɨka'itiya wahetsiemieme
Yawé Muitsexi meta 'Aruni mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'aitɨani
'ixaheritsixi mɨpaɨ memɨtewataxatɨanikɨ: «Yunaime yeutari kwiepa memɨtexɨawe, 'ikɨ mekanihɨkɨtɨni xepɨyɨwaweni xemɨwakwa'anikɨ:
Wakarutsa manutahuhuta meta hutarieka memɨte'iyawa.
Matsita mekanixɨaweni hipatɨ mete'iyawatɨ wakarutsa ka'anutahuhutatɨ. Xemɨkawakwa'ani 'ikɨ mepɨhɨkɨ: »Kameyu pɨti'iyawa matsi karutsaya pɨka'anutahuhuta, mɨkɨ pɨka'itiya xehetsiemieme.
»Tatsiu pɨti'iyawa matsi karutsaya pɨka'anutahuta, mɨkɨta pɨka'itiya xehetsiemieme.
»Yaxeikɨata tatsiu hepaɨ mɨ'ane mɨkɨta pɨti'iyawa matsi karutsaya pɨkahanutahuhuta, mɨkɨ xepɨkakwa'ani mɨka'itiyakɨ xehetsiemieme.
»Tuixu meta karutsaya panutahuhuta matsi pɨkati'iyawa, mɨkɨ pɨka'itiya xehetsiemieme.
»Waiyarieya xepɨkakwa'ani meta mekwikwi'ime xepɨkawakumaɨwani. Mɨkɨ xehetsiemieme mepɨka'itiya.
»Hapa memɨteye'uwa, haramaratetsie meta muyehapanetsie 'ikɨ mekanihɨkɨtɨni xeikɨa xeme xemɨwakwa'ani: Memeukakararayatɨka yuhauweme memexeiya naitsata.
Yuhauweme meta yukararayari memɨkahexeiya, tsepa haramaratsie meta hatuxametsie memɨye'uwa, mɨkɨ xeme xepɨwaxani'erieka.
Waiyarieya xepɨkakwa'ani mɨkime xepɨxani'erieka, mɨkɨ pɨka'itiya xehetsiemieme.
Yunaitɨ hapa memɨteye'uwa yuhauweme memɨkahexeiya meta memɨkaheukararayatɨka mɨkɨ xepɨwaxani'erieka meta mepɨka'itiya xehetsiemieme.
»'Ikɨ mekanihɨkɨtɨni memɨte'awɨwawe xeme xemɨwaxani'erieka meta xemɨkawakwa'ani: Werika, 'umete mumura, kwixɨ meta maraika,
yunaitɨ hukurixi meta wahepaɨ memɨ'anene hipatɨ,
meta yunaime kwatsari xepɨkawakwa'ani,
meta 'aru 'amɨnena, nɨpe, meta yunaitɨ yɨkɨ memɨ'anene paturi wahepaɨ memɨ'anene,
mikɨri, kwaxu meutsinaɨye, patu,
tɨkaipu, patu hepaɨ mɨ'ane 'amanuyepa, wirɨkɨ.
Kwaxu 'amɨnena, meta yunaitɨ yɨkɨ memɨ'anene kwaxuri, tsurakai meta 'atsixi.
»Yunaitɨ memɨte'awɨwawe menauka 'ɨkatɨkaitɨ mɨkɨ xepɨwamaika memɨka'itiyakɨ,
Hipatɨta memuxɨawe naukamekɨ meheu'uwatɨ meta me'awɨwawetɨ, mɨkɨ xemɨwatikwani xepɨyɨwawe, mɨkɨta wakarutsa peukakukuni meta mepɨyɨwawe memɨtitsunaxɨani,
meta yunaitɨ 'utsikari wahepaɨ memɨte'anene 'ɨtsita memeutsunatɨka meta xuxuitsi.
Peru hipatɨ naukamekɨ memu'uwe meta mema'anatɨka, xeme xepɨkawakwa'ani mɨkɨ mepɨka'itiyatɨka.
'Inɨari niukiyarite yeuta mɨtiuyeika xɨkatiumayɨani mɨkati'itiya
»Xeme 'ikɨ wakɨmana xeka'itiyatɨ xepuyuhayewa: »Kemɨ'ane xeme mɨkɨ mekwikwi'ime mɨwamayɨani mɨkɨ ka'itiyatɨ puyuhayewa kepaukake mɨkɨyɨretsie.
»Kemɨ'ane mɨkime manukukweni, mɨkɨ kaneuyeweka yu'ixurikite mɨti'ekwa, mɨkɨ ka'itiyatɨ puyuhayewa kepaukake mɨkɨyɨretsie.
»Xemeri xepɨwaxeiyani yeutari memɨka'itiyatɨka meta yunaime kemɨ'ane mɨka'anutahuhuta wakarutsate meta mɨkareka'iyawame. Tsepa kemɨ'ane mimayɨani ka'itiyatɨ kanayeimɨkɨ.
»Meta memɨtexɨawe naukamekɨ me'u'uwetɨ memeu'uwa, mɨkɨta memɨka'itiya xepɨtewamaika yukɨtsimekɨ me'u'uwetɨ memɨteku'uwa, kemɨ'ane mɨkime mɨmayɨani ka'itiyatɨ kanayeimɨkɨ kepauka mɨkɨyɨretsieke,
yunaitɨ kemɨ'ane menukuhana kaneuyeweka yu'ixɨriki memɨti'ekwa, meta meka'itiyatɨ mepakɨne kepauka mɨkɨyuretsieke. Mɨkɨ yeutari xeme memɨka'itiya xepɨtewamaika.
»Yunaitɨ memɨtexɨawe yutawima memɨteku'uwa, mɨkɨ memɨka'itiyatɨka mepɨhɨkɨtɨni: kɨrupuxi, naikatsi meta katsaxi hipatɨ yukɨmemɨ'anene,
mataika, ketse, tekaxi, kuu 'iwipame,
'ikɨ mekanihɨkɨtɨni yeutari xeme meka'itiyakame xemɨwarayeitɨaka yutawima memɨteku'uwa watsata. Kemɨ'ane mɨkime mɨmayɨani mɨkɨ ka'itiyatɨ kaniyuhayewamɨkɨ kepauka mɨkɨyɨretsieke.
Hipatɨ tawari 'inɨari niukiyarite kwiepa memɨtexuawe memɨka'itiyatɨka xɨka wakumaɨwani

»Kepauka yeutanaka waiyarieya mɨkitɨ ka'itiyatɨ tixaɨtɨ kɨyetsie mɨtikaweni, yatɨni 'ixurikitsie, yatɨni nawitsie, yatɨni kamixa 'amayetsuye yamɨranakatɨkietsie, mɨkɨ ka'itiyatɨ kanayeimɨkɨ. Kaneuyeweka hakɨ mɨtahauxinirekɨ, meta ka'itiyatɨ kaniyuhayewamɨkɨ kepaukake mukɨyɨretsie. Hikɨ 'ana 'itiyatɨ kanayeimɨkɨ.
»Xɨka xewitɨ 'ikɨ yeutari waiyarieya mɨkitɨ haxu xariyarita heukaweni, mɨkɨ xari meta tita muwa mɨtiyepika kati'itiyatɨ kanayeimɨkɨ, kaneuyeweka xari mitatararienikɨ.
Naitɨ 'ikwaitsie haa xarita mieme xɨka 'ukayeurieni ka'itiyatɨ kanayeimɨkɨ, yaxeikɨata tita mɨti'iwa mɨkɨ xariyarita timieme ka'itiyatɨ payani.
Xɨka kaxari yapaɨmetɨ tixaɨtɨtsie tiukaweni mɨkɨ ka'itiyatɨ payani, kaneuyeweka mita'unakɨ huxunu meta huxiniyu hetsiena mukawekɨ. Mɨkɨ kaxari pɨka'itiya mɨpaɨ xepute'ixeiyani.
Peru xeikɨa haixa muhanetsiemieme meta putsuta hakewa haa matihawa pɨ'itiyaka xeikɨa, matsi kemɨ'ane yeutanaka kaxarieya mɨkime mɨmayɨani tsepa kemɨtitita ka'itiyatɨ kaniyuhayewamɨkɨ.
»Xɨka xewitɨ mɨkɨ yeutari mɨkitɨ ra'imɨarita heukaweni, mɨkɨ hatsi 'itiyatɨ puyuhayewani.
Peru xɨka 'imɨari hapa 'utihawiya, xɨka tixɨatɨ timɨkitɨ mana tikaweni, ka'itiyakame xekanayeitɨakakuni.
»Xɨka tewa mupitɨariekai mitakwanikekaikɨ hekuwiekaku 'umɨni, kemɨ'ane mɨkime mimayɨani, mɨkɨta ka'itiyatɨ puyuhayewa kepauka mɨkɨyɨretsieke.

Kemɨ'ane mɨkɨ waiyaririeya mitakwani, mɨkɨ yukemari pɨti'ekwa ka'itiyatɨ puyuhayewa kepauka mɨkɨyɨretsieke. Kemɨ'ane menukweni mɨkɨta yu'ixurikite pɨti'ekwa ka'itiyatɨ pɨyuhayewa kepauka mɨkɨyɨretsieke.
Keyupaɨmetɨ memɨtexɨawe kwiepa yutawima memɨteku'uwa meta 'aixɨa memɨ'anene
»Yutawima memuyukuhapatɨwe xepɨkawakwa'ani, mɨkɨ xepɨwaxani'erieka.
Xepɨkatewakwa'ani yutawima mukuyeika, yanɨtsɨtɨni yukɨtsimekɨ memu'uwe, yatɨni waɨkawa 'ɨkate memexeiyatɨka. Xeimetɨma xepɨkakwaka yutawima memɨteku'uwa mɨkɨ memɨka'itiyakɨ,
xepɨka'ipitɨaka mɨkɨkɨ xeka'itiyatɨ xemakɨnekɨ, mɨkɨ memɨka'itiyakɨ.
Ne Yawé xekakaɨyari nepɨhɨkɨ, xekeneyupatani xepatsietɨ xekeneyuhayewani, ne nemupatsiekɨ. 'Ayumieme xeka'itiyatɨ xepɨkayuhayewani kwiepa yutawima memɨteku'uwa wahekɨ.
Ne Yawé nekanihɨkɨtɨni, nemɨxe'ayewitɨ 'Ekipitu kwieyaritsie, xekakaɨyari nemayanikɨ. Xemeta xekenepatsieka ne nemɨpatsiekɨ.
Kememɨteheutiparitɨa
»'Ikɨ 'inɨari niukiyari kanihɨkɨtɨni: memɨte'awɨwawe wahetsiemieme, yunaime meta hapa memɨteye'uwa, meta yunaime yutawima memɨteku'uwa,
mɨpaɨ xemɨyɨwawenikɨ xemɨwamatenikɨ kemɨ'ane mɨ'itiya meta mɨka'itiya, meta kemɨ'ane memɨtakwani meta kemɨ'ane memɨkatakwa'anikɨ».
